title: Freeze schemas for tools and stream-json
description: Define stable schemas for stream-json events and JSON-RPC tool contracts (MVP: renderdoc.get_context). Keep the scope limited to MVP and document compatibility rules.
acceptance_criteria: A checked-in schema/spec exists for stream-json and renderdoc.get_context; sample fixtures validate; reviewers can point to the exact schema version used by qrenderdoc and Agent Host.
review_initial_requirements: Schema names are ASCII; error envelopes are defined; no breaking change without explicit version bump; tool allow-list and security notes included.
review_regression_requirements: Existing UI parser still accepts the event stream; fixtures remain valid; schema diffs reviewed before merge.
notes: picked_reason:P0 schema/spec unblocks all subsequent implementation;done_at:2026-01-19;evidence:python scripts/ai_agent/validate_fixtures.py => ok

title: Implement Node Agent Host skeleton (SDK + streaming)
description: Create a Node-based Agent Host using CodeBuddy Agent SDK that reads prompts from stdin and emits stream-json events to stdout. Register tools (initially renderdoc.get_context).
acceptance_criteria: When launched manually, Agent Host prints init/message/result in stream-json; supports model override; exits non-zero on fatal error; supports cancel/timeout without hanging.
review_initial_requirements: No runtime node_modules requirement (bundle plan); deterministic output; secrets not logged; cancellation path reviewed; tool registration uses explicit allow-list.
review_regression_requirements: Handles empty prompt/EOF gracefully; large outputs do not break JSON-line framing; error codes/messages stable for UI.
notes: picked_reason:P0 provides executable backend for UI integration;done_at:2026-01-19;evidence:npm run typecheck; npm run build; manual run emits init/message/result

title: Auth reuse via codebuddy CLI login (detect + surface)
description: Reuse existing codebuddy CLI login credentials and add a clear login state check. Map auth failures to actionable stream-json error output for qrenderdoc UI.
acceptance_criteria: If user is not logged in, Agent Host emits an error event instructing how to fix (codebuddy login) and exits non-zero; if logged in, session starts normally; no credential material is printed.
review_initial_requirements: Error messages are actionable and stable; no leaking tokens; retry behavior and timeouts are bounded.
review_regression_requirements: Logged-in and logged-out flows verified; UI displays auth errors correctly; no regressions in normal chat output.
notes: picked_reason:P0 auth check avoids confusing failures and enables actionable UI errors;done_at:2026-01-19;evidence:npm run typecheck; npm run build; manual run emits auth_required stream-json;validation_limited:logged-in flow not verified;manual_test:run codebuddy then /login (or set CODEBUDDY_API_KEY) then rerun host;risk:medium

title: Add in-app Python JSON-RPC bridge (HTTP, localhost-only)
description: Implement a Python 3.6 in-app JSON-RPC 2.0 HTTP server bound to 127.0.0.1 with token auth, exposing renderdoc.get_context by reading current ICaptureContext state.
acceptance_criteria: Bridge starts on AI panel open and stops on app exit; /rpc rejects missing/invalid token; renderdoc.get_context returns capture_path/api/event_id/event_name; logs include request id and latency.
review_initial_requirements: No UI-thread blocking; localhost-only bind; random per-session token; request/response logging is structured and redacts secrets.
review_regression_requirements: Bridge remains stable across multiple AI queries; errors are handled without crashing qrenderdoc; tool output remains valid when no capture is loaded.
notes: picked_reason:P0 implement tool bridge early to unblock host+UI;done_at:2026-01-19;evidence:python extracted embedded bridge script start+auth+get_context ok;validation_limited:no qrenderdoc build/run in this env;manual_test:open qrenderdoc then query /rpc with Authorization Bearer token;risk:medium integration pending

title: Wire Agent Host tool call to JSON-RPC bridge
description: Implement renderdoc.get_context tool execution in Agent Host by calling the in-app JSON-RPC /rpc endpoint and returning the structured result to the agent.
acceptance_criteria: In qrenderdoc AI panel, a prompt triggers tool_call renderdoc.get_context; tool_result is shown in UI; assistant answer includes values from tool_result; failures show error with correlation id.
review_initial_requirements: HTTP client enforces timeouts; token passed only via header; tool errors map to stable UI-visible error events; logs include request id.
review_regression_requirements: Repeated queries do not leak processes/sockets; tool still works after cancel and re-run; tool_result schema matches Phase 1.

title: Switch CodeBuddyAssistant backend to bundled Agent Host
description: Replace the current codebuddy CLI process launch with bundled Node + Agent Host, passing model and bridge discovery info while keeping stream-json rendering.
acceptance_criteria: AI panel runs Agent Host; model field is honored; cancel stops the running request; stdout/stderr are surfaced cleanly; legacy codebuddy CLI path is not required for MVP.
review_initial_requirements: Process launch path is explicit and logged; handles missing bundled Node with a clear error; no UI freezes while reading output.
review_regression_requirements: Existing stream-json parsing still works; cancel/retry works; errors do not leave zombie processes.

title: Package portable Node runtime and Agent Host bundle
description: Bundle a portable Node runtime with RenderDoc and ship the Agent Host as a single JS bundle with predictable paths and discovery order.
acceptance_criteria: Distribution layout contains portable Node + Agent Host bundle; qrenderdoc prefers bundled node and falls back to PATH; UI logs which node path is selected; no node_modules needed at runtime.
review_initial_requirements: Paths are platform-agnostic where possible; security/update notes recorded; bundle size and licensing reviewed.
review_regression_requirements: A clean machine without Node in PATH still runs the AI panel successfully; fallback behavior verified.

title: Verification: typecheck, unit tests, and end-to-end flow
description: Define and run the minimal validation set for the MVP: Node typecheck/unit tests plus qrenderdoc build and a manual E2E checklist.
acceptance_criteria: Node typecheck and unit tests pass; qrenderdoc compiles+links with warnings-as-errors; manual E2E checklist confirms tool_call/tool_result displayed and renderdoc.get_context returns correct values.
review_initial_requirements: Tests cover schema marshalling and error mapping; E2E checklist is explicit and reproducible; logs are sufficient for diagnosis.
review_regression_requirements: Re-run validation on a second capture; verify cancel/retry; ensure no crash/hang across multiple sessions.

title: Phase 2 backlog: additional tools and safe modify actions
description: Break down post-MVP tools (pipeline summary, shader reflection, statistics, modify actions) into separate follow-up work with explicit security gating and confirmations.
acceptance_criteria: A follow-up plan/issues snapshot exists listing prioritized tools with schemas, acceptance criteria, and security/confirmation requirements for any modify actions.
review_initial_requirements: Avoid scope creep in MVP; define tool boundaries and data policy; require explicit user confirmation for any modify action.
review_regression_requirements: Phase 2 plan stays compatible with Phase 1 schemas; new tools added only via allow-list updates and tests.
